read.name: EnrichOrganization
read.description:
Turn a company domain into firmographics (industry, size, revenue, funding,
location) so a rep can qualify and size an account. Consumes one enrichment
credit on a match; when the plan is out of credits the result reports
status=insufficient_credits rather than failing.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Company domain to look up, such as apollo.io. A full URL or www prefix is accepted and normalized.

output.description: The matched company, or found=False when no match.

write.name: AttachFileToTask
write.description:
Attaches a file to an Asana task

Provide exactly one of file_content_str, file_content_base64, or file_content_url, never more
than one.

- Use file_content_str for text files (will be encoded using file_encoding)
- Use file_content_base64 for binary files like images, PDFs, etc.
- Use file_content_url if the file is hosted on an external URL

toolkit.name: Asana
toolkit.description: Arcade tools designed for LLMs to interact with Asana

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: The ID of the task to attach the file to.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: The name of the file to attach with format extension. E.g. 'Image.png' or 'Report.pdf'.

parameters.name: file_content_str
parameters.description: The string contents of the file to attach. Use this if the file is a text file. Defaults to None.

parameters.name: file_content_base64
parameters.description: The base64-encoded binary contents of the file. Use this for binary files like images or PDFs. Defaults to None.

parameters.name: file_content_url
parameters.description: The URL of the file to attach. Use this if the file is hosted on an external URL. Defaults to None.

parameters.name: file_encoding
parameters.description: The encoding of the file to attach. Only used with file_content_str. Defaults to 'utf-8'.

output.description: The task with the file attached.

unclassified.name: AddBaseCollaborator
unclassified.description:
Add a collaborator to an Airtable base.

    Use this tool to add a new collaborator to a specified Airtable base. It facilitates inviting one collaborator at a time.

    Note: Understanding the request schema is necessary to properly create
    the stringified JSON input object for execution.

This operation also requires path parameters.

    Modes:
    - GET_REQUEST_SCHEMA: Returns the schema. Only call if you don't
      already have it. Do NOT call repeatedly if you already received
      the schema.
    - EXECUTE: Performs the operation with the provided request body
      JSON.
      Note: You must also provide the required path parameters when executing.

    If you need the schema, call with mode='get_request_schema' ONCE, then execute.

toolkit.name: AirtableApi
toolkit.description: Tools that enable LLMs to interact directly with the airtable API.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Operation mode: 'get_request_schema' returns the OpenAPI spec for the request body, 'execute' performs the actual operation

parameters.name: base_id
parameters.description: The ID of the Airtable base to which the collaborator will be added.  Required when mode is 'execute', ignored when mode is 'get_request_schema'.

parameters.name: request_body
parameters.description: Stringified JSON representing the request body. Required when mode is 'execute', ignored when mode is 'get_request_schema'
